[{"page_content": "19. Promotional Discount and Coupon Policy
Promotional codes are subject to their individual campaign terms.
Common restrictions include: - minimum basket value, - eligible product categories, - one code per order, -
customer-account restrictions, - campaign expiration, - geographic restrictions, - seller restrictions, - exclusion of
already discounted items.
A coupon cannot normally be converted to cash.
19.1 Failed Coupon Application
If a coupon fails at checkout, the customer should first verify the campaign requirements. Support may manually
investigate only when the customer provides enough information to reproduce the issue.
19.2 Returns After Promotion
When a customer returns one product from a discounted multi-item order, the refund engine recalculates the
applicable discount. A customer should not automatically expect the full undiscounted price of the returned
product.
19.3 Price Adjustments
Nimbus Commerce may provide a price adjustment within 7 days when a qualifying price difference is caused by
a Nimbus Commerce price change. Promotional coupon differences are excluded unless the promotion terms
state otherwise.

Customer Support Policy Overview
Nimbus Commerce operates an online marketplace selling apparel, footwear, electronics, home appliances, beauty
and personal-care products, furniture, sports equipment, accessories, and selected digital products.
This knowledge base defines the default customer-support rules for orders placed directly through Nimbus
Commerce. Individual product pages, promotional campaigns, seller-specific terms, and legally mandatory
consumer rights may override a general rule when explicitly stated.
Customer-support agents should identify the customer’sorder number, product category, fulfillment
method, payment method, order status, delivery date, and issue typebefore deciding eligibility. If a
policy depends on information stored in the order system, the agent must use the order-data tool rather than
guessing.
A policy answer should distinguish between: - what the customer is eligible to request, - what Nimbus Commerce
has approved, - what action has already been performed, - and what action is still pending.
When two rules appear to conflict, the more specific rule normally takes precedence over a general rule. For
example, a category-specific warranty term overrides the generic warranty term, and a promotion-specific return
rule overrides the normal return window when the promotion explicitly states that restriction.
